title: Spinach Omelette
description: A fluffy vegetarian omelette with a splash of milk and fresh tomato. The spinach is the one thing you still need to buy.

instructions.title: Prep
instructions.description: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper, and dice the tomato.

instructions.title: Wilt
instructions.description: Heat the oil in a pan and wilt the spinach for a minute, then add the tomato.
instructions.tip: Squeeze the spinach dry so the omelette stays fluffy.

instructions.title: Cook
instructions.description: Pour in the eggs and cook until set, folding the omelette in half to serve.
